title: Check Anagrams
description: Given two strings `s` and `t`, return `true` if `t` is an anagram of `s`, and `false` otherwise.
input_format: Two lines, each containing a string.
hints: Two strings are anagrams if every character appears with the same frequency in both.
Sort both strings and check if they are identical.
Alternatively, use a frequency counter map for O(n) time.

reference_solution:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().split()
if len(lines) >= 2:
    from collections import Counter
    print('true' if Counter(lines[0]) == Counter(lines[1]) else 'false')
else:
    print('false')
